title: New NIH Funding Opportunity - Pilot Projects Enhancing Utility and Usage of Common Fund Data Sets (R03 Clinical Trial Not Allowed)
bodyHtml:
The National Institutes of Health (NIH) has announced a new funding opportunity aimed at unlocking the potential of its Common Fund data sets. Over the years, the NIH Common Fund has generated a treasure trove of research data, and now, they're looking for innovative projects that can demonstrate and expand the value of these resources.  

What’s on Offer? 

Award funding is available to support projects that use Common Fund datasets to generate new hypotheses, catalyze scientific discoveries, or provide novel insights into biomedical research. Recipients will also play a key role in evaluating and providing feedback on the utility of these data resources, helping the NIH refine and improve its data offerings for the broader research community.

Who Can Apply?

The call is open to a wide variety of U.S.-based organizations, including:

  • Nonprofit organizations (including Native American tribal organizations)
  • Educational institutions (public, private, and independent)
  • Government entities (state, city, county, tribal, housing authorities, and special districts)
  • For-profit businesses (including small businesses). 

It’s important to note that foreign organizations and any applications involving foreign subawards or subcontracts are not eligible for this funding. U.S.-based organizations can include foreign components or consultants, but direct international monetary collaborations must be submitted under a different, specifically designated opportunity.

Why Participate?

This is a unique chance to leverage rich, well-curated datasets that have already impacted many areas of research. By participating, you could drive the next wave of biomedical discoveries—while also helping NIH shape the future of open research data.  

How to Learn More

For full eligibility criteria and application instructions, visit the Common Fund website or reach out to the Common Fund Data Ecosystem team at CFDE@od.nih.gov. Don’t miss this chance to turn open data into open discovery!
summary: The NIH Common Fund is offering funding to demonstrate and enhance the utility of its widely available research data sets. This opportunity is open to a broad range of U.S.-based organizations, including educational institutions, nonprofits, and businesses. Projects should focus on using Common Fund data to generate hypotheses and drive new discoveries, with awardees expected to provide feedback on their experiences.
